title: Collection Type
description: A collection can be a set of files with identical information model and serialization/formatting, or a heterogeneous set of files that together constitute a dataset (a composite dataset).

ada:componentType.description: ADA componentType for a collection, as a single string. Allowed values are constrained at the technique-profile level (each adaProfile's schema:hasPart anyOf enumerates the allowed values for that technique, either inline or via a $ref to a detail<Tech> schema). No enum here so that profile-specific componentTypes (e.g. ada:XANESCollection, ada:LIT2DDataCollection) do not require updates to this branch schema.

ada:memberTypes.title: String Array Type
ada:memberTypes.description: List of the component types in the collection

ada:nFiles.description: Number of files in the collection, including metadata files

ada:fileName.description: Full path to file in container object

ada:fileNamePattern.description: Pattern for collection members with differentiating suffix at '*'

ada:componentType.description: componentType of an individual file within the collection. Not constrained to the collection-level enum, since a collection holds heterogeneous files (each carrying its own file-type componentType).
